# A method that is not defined on the receiver gets its signature synthesized
# from the call's arguments: each use becomes a parameter of the argument's
# default type, and later uses of a repeated argument are numbered.

muxt generate --use-receiver-type=T
stdout 'note: T does not define F\(request \*http.Request, request2 \*http.Request, id string, id2 string\) any'
grep 'F\(request \*http.Request, request2 \*http.Request, id string, id2 string\) any' template_routes.go

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET /{id} F(request, request, id, id)" -}}ok{{- end -}}
